architecture_decision: No runtime replacement selected; isolated server wake handoff is too small to explain the observed headroom gap
schedule: 200 trials per candidate per block,100ms gaps; block1 plain/instrumented/traced and floor then zmosh; block2 traced/instrumented/plain and zmosh then floor
limitations: Scheduling spans measure unique response readiness to first same-connection driver service, not a particular UDP packet or actual OS task wakeup
Resource windows include post-warmup trial gaps and export control, not just timed per-request CPU
Two reversed blocks do not isolate pure causal tracing overhead; build-mode and host variation remain
Independent host workloads were active; exclusive machine use is not claimed
Protocol processing, socket cost, and client-side scheduling remain incompletely attributed
This echo floor has no remote PTY and does not qualify production behavior
